jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer - Banking
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

As a Senior Value Engineer specializing in Banking, you are at the forefront of solving business-critical problems for some of the world's largest financial institutions. You will work intimately with strategic enterprise clients to understand their complex objectives—ranging from accelerating Loan Origination and Client Onboarding to optimizing Capital Markets Operations and Regulatory Reporting.

You will build Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with top AI and ML technology partners. By feeding operational context to AI, you help banks understand the intricate realities of their massive transactional ecosystems. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Banking Executives (COOs, CROs, and Heads of Digital Transformation), and ensure successful implementation and value realization to solidify and expand the Celonis footprint across the global financial landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

- AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand the clients' overarching AI strategies and the distinct challenges inherent to Banking (e.g., fraud detection, credit risk assessment, and automating KYC/AML). Translate complex financial workflows into innovative AI solutions that drive measurable ROI.

- Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Actively drive the customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during the expansion cycle. Remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation, ensuring efficiency and adoption thresholds are met.

- Hackathons & Prototyping: Think creatively to tackle heavily siloed legacy core-banking systems. Leverage cutting-edge AI to rapidly build prototypes in client hackathons, solving pain points across Settlements, Reconciliations, and Payments.

- Agentic Process Transformation: Support enterprise clients in shifting from rule-based automation to autonomous AI agents. Enable "intelligent" banking processes, such as autonomous exception handling in Trade Ops or automated Complaints Management.

- Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. Architect secure, scalable LLM/agent systems (with RAG and guardrails) that integrate with complex enterprise stacks like SAP Banking, Salesforce FINS, or core-banking ledgers.

- Domain Practitioner Leadership: Serve as a functional subject matter expert for the Banking value chain, scaling knowledge across the organization regarding the nuances of financial operations and transaction lifecycles.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Requirements:

- 5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales and post-sales engagements specifically within complex Banking or Financial Services environments. This includes building ROI business cases and guiding technical implementations.

- Strong Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the banking value chain, with the ability to translate operational needs into AI use cases across:

- Lending & Onboarding: Loan Origination, KYC/AML, and Banking & Lending.

- Capital Markets: Sales & Trading Ops, Settlements, Reconciliations, and Custody Services.

- Support & Governance: Finance, Risk & Controls, and Regulatory/Transaction Reporting.

- Expertise in Generative AI Techniques: Knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, and multi-agent orchestration used to build high-impact use cases (e.g., intelligent compliance assistants or automated data extraction from complex trade documentation).

- Technical Fluency: Solid knowledge of Python and common ML/Data libraries (e.g., pandas, LangChain) as well as SQL for handling massive, high-velocity transactional datasets.

- Communication: Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders, from technical whiteboarding with IT to formal demos for Banking Directors.

- Degree: Bachelor’s Degree required; Master's Degree in Finance, Computer Science, Economics, or Mathematics preferred.

Nice to Have:

- Agentic Systems: Hands-on experience building systems using LLM orchestration and function calling within highly regulated "Data Sovereignty" environments.

- Banking Systems: Familiarity with FSI-specific platforms (e.g., nCino, Guidewire, FIS, Fiserv, or Bloomberg).

- Cloud Platforms: Experience deploying models across major cloud providers (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex).

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

Our Internal Mobility Program provides you with career path options - not just based on what you’ve been doing, but based on what you could do for other teams, functions, or locations. We believe in your potential, that’s why we hired you, and that’s why we’re excited to share a new job opportunity with you.

The Role:

As a Principal Value Engineer, you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform.

In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set, with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

The work you’ll do:

This role is essentially that of a consultant. Your job is to help customers adopt the Celonis product (software) and support them all the way through to achieving tangible business improvements.

Identify & Frame Value

(This is the “proposal” phase, before the customer buys or fully implements Celonis.)

- Discover Customer Needs: You’ll start by understanding a customer’s top strategic goals. Your job is to translate those goals into specific use cases where Celonis can have a high impact.

- Build the Business Case: To help win new customers, you will create product demos and compelling presentations (business cases). These will show the customer, often using industry benchmarks, how much value (e.g., cost savings, efficiency gains) they can expect.

- Present to Executives: You will run small-scale “Proof of Value” (PoV) projects (like a trial) to test the software on their data. You will then present the results, the value opportunity you found, and a strategic roadmap to their C-Level executives.

Realize Value

(This is the “execution” phase, after the customer has started using Celonis.)

- Find Improvement Opportunities: You will lead workshops with the customer. Using the Celonis platform to analyze their business data, you will pinpoint specific opportunities for process improvement.

- Drive Change: You will help develop concrete improvement measures and work with the customer to launch internal change initiatives to fix the problems you’ve identified.

- Report the Results: You will present the concrete results and the actual value realized (e.g., “We improved process X, which saved $Y”) to the customer’s senior management.

Scale Value

(This is the “expansion” phase, focused on long-term adoption and growth.)

- Manage the Full Customer Journey: You are responsible for the customer’s entire relationship with Celonis—from their initial use (landing) to helping them use it in new departments (expanding), ensuring they use it effectively (adoption), and making sure they renew their contract.

- Build a Strategic Roadmap: You will work with the customer to create a long-term plan to embed Celonis as a core platform for business transformation in their organization.

- Provide Product Feedback: You will take what you learn from customers and new use cases back to the Celonis product development teams to help make the platform and apps even better.

Qualifications and Experience:

Value Selling or Consultative Sales

- Experience leading a consultative process: discovering customer needs, qualifying opportunities, building a business case (value assessment), and running Proof of Value (PoV) projects.

- A proven ability to demonstrate and sell based on “value” (like ROI or strategic impact) rather than just product features.

Technical Product Familiarity (especially SaaS)

- A strong understanding of SaaS platforms or complex IT solutions, allowing you to hold technical discussions with a customer’s IT team.

- Hands-on experience building technical demos, such as creating dashboards, simple applications, or automated workflows.

Value Realization or Customer Success

- Experience in a post-sales role (like Customer Success or Implementation Consultant) focused on helping customers achieve business results with a product.

- A track record of driving user adoption, training users, helping establish an operating model (like a “Center of Excellence”), and ultimately securing renewals or expansions.

Project Management

- The ability to manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously (especially IT-related projects), controlling their scope, timeline, and stakeholder expectations.

- Experience coordinating with both internal teams and external partners (like consulting firms) to deliver a project successfully.

Executive Stakeholder Management

- Proven experience preparing materials for and presenting results to senior leaders (C-Level, VPs), both externally (at the customer) and internally.

- Comfortable with communicating, negotiating, and managing expectations at an executive level.

Domain Expertise (Specific Business Functions)

- Deep knowledge or practical experience in specific business functions, such as Finance (e.g., Accounts Payable) or Supply Chain (e.g., Procurement, Order Management).

- Experience with large-scale transformation initiatives (e.g., Shared Services or ERP system migrations).

Industry Expertise (Specific Verticals)

- A strong understanding of the trends, challenges, and strategic opportunities within a specific industry (e.g., Manufacturing, Banking, Retail).

- Experience tailoring proposals and roadmaps to address the specific C-suite agenda of that industry.

- Strategic Vision: Proven ability to think strategically, guiding your team to connect technical solutions to business value and customer objectives.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of navigating complex negotiations and presenting to C-level executives.

You must be able to comfortably switch from discussing high-level architecture strategy to understanding hands-on demo environments.

jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

- Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

- Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

- Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements

- Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

- Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

- Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

- Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

- Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

- Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

- Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

- Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

- Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually

- You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly

- You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers

- You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer

- You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need

- Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.

- Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.

- AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

- Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

- Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.

- Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

- Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

- Languages: Fluency in English and German required.

- Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

The Celonis Business Apps IT team brings together product managers and data engineers to build best-in-class, composable solutions for enterprise system transformation. In close alignment with the Celonis and Oracle go-to-market partnership, this team develops purpose-built solutions for Oracle source systems, including Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft, and Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications. These solutions help customers understand how their operations actually run, accelerate and de-risk modernization to Oracle Fusion Cloud, and provide the operational context needed to scale Enterprise AI. The team combines hands-on technical depth, customer focus, and a product mindset to create repeatable offerings that can be adopted across the Oracle customer base.

The Role:

We're looking for a hybrid between a product manager and an engineer: someone who can sit with an Oracle customer, understand a process or modernization challenge, and then design and build the solution with the rest of the team rather than handing it off. Afterwards, you extract the knowledge from your deployments and feed them back into the Celonis knowledge layer, ensuring scalability for future deployments. You'll operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where shipping quickly matters more than perfect process and where the line between designing and building the product is intentionally blurry. You will get hands-on with Oracle data, process models, applications, and AI-driven workflows on the Celonis platform, iterating directly with the customers and partners who will use them.

You'll be at the center of the Celonis and Oracle partnership, turning joint go-to-market priorities into working products that accelerate Oracle modernization and deliver measurable customer value. If you're energized by owning an Oracle-focused solution portfolio end-to-end, moving fast, and being measured by adoption and impact, this is for you.

The work you'll do:

Your mission is to build the Oracle-focused solution portfolio that turns the Celonis and Oracle partnership strategy into repeatable products customers can deploy. You will combine Celonis Process Intelligence and the Celonis Context Model with Oracle application and process expertise to help customers modernize with confidence and scale Enterprise AI with trusted operational context.

- Own the roadmap and ship purpose-built, reusable solutions for Oracle source systems and pain points

- Build solutions that help customers discover process complexity, identify high-risk customizations, benchmark performance, and create data-driven modernization roadmaps for Oracle Fusion Cloud

- Use Celonis Process Intelligence and the Celonis Context Model to create operational context for finance, supply chain, and other core processes, including Oracle AI agents and AI services running on OCI

The Role

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

jobs.description:

Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer (Java) to join the Provisioning & Licensing team. This is a high-impact role that demands significant autonomy and ownership, driving the technical design and delivery of mission-critical systems.

You will be responsible for our core provisioning pipeline. Additionally, you will apply your expertise and technical knowledge to support the development of our strategic Self-Managed Platform Solution for highly regulated environments. If you thrive on complexity, enjoy taking architectural contributions from design to production, and want to own systems that directly enable multi-million dollar market expansion, this is your next role.

The Team: Provisioning & Licensing

You will be part of the Provisioning & Licensing team, the vital "glue team" between our business functions and the core platform.

- The team owns the latency-sensitive internal APIs for automatically creating new tenants based on customer data, as well as our internal Feature & Configuration system (like a car configurator, just for microservices!).

- Your team is a central internal unit with many touchpoints across other engineering teams and business teams like Licensing Management.

- When it comes to prioritization, we value your input and expect you to contribute actively to the prioritization discussions in our dynamic environment.

The Tech Stack

Our stack is modern, cloud-native, and focused on portability to support our strategic on-premise deployments.

- Core Technologies: Java 25, Spring Boot, Postgres as the main datastore.

- Containerization: We are all in on containerization and orchestration, running our applications on Kubernetes (K8s).

- Architecture: We develop within a new & modern modular monolithic application with strongly enforced boundaries between the modules.

- DevOps: Writing deployment files with the help of Kustomize and deploying our applications with Github CI and Kargo. We use Datadog for metrics, logs, and as our APM tool.

The Role:

A strong partner ecosystem doesn't just support the growth of a business — it ignites innovation, amplifies reach, and creates a powerful network effect that moves the entire business forward. This role is 100% dedicated to the newly established Celonis–Oracle strategic partnership, one of Celonis' highest-priority global alliances. As Principal Partner Marketing Principal, Oracle Partnership, you will serve as the senior marketing leader accountable for translating executive partnership strategy into measurable market impact — driving awareness, demand generation, executive engagement, customer advocacy, and joint go-to-market activation that accelerates pipeline and strengthens Celonis' position within the Oracle ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage a team, but you will operate as a cross-functional leader, influencing and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Strategic Partnerships, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Corporate Communications, Analyst Relations, and Oracle Marketing to drive results.

- Own the Global Oracle Partner Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute the integrated marketing strategy supporting the Celonis & Oracle partnership globally. This includes building the annual Oracle marketing plan, campaign calendar, and investment priorities - aligning with Oracle sales priorities, executive objectives, and partnership milestones.

- Drive Integrated Demand Generation: Design and execute full-funnel integrated campaigns spanning digital marketing, email, paid media, executive outreach, webinars, marketplace promotions, sales plays, and customer marketing. You should also bring a field lens to program design, ensuring campaigns connect to regional priorities and translate to pipeline in target accounts within prioritized regions.

- Develop Thought Leadership: Partner with our product marketing team to develop industry positioning and competitive differentiation that you can then use as a foundation for developing joint press, joint analyst briefings, thought leadership content, blogs, customer stories, and videos in collaboration with the corporate communications and analyst relations team.

- Serve as the Primary Marketing Interface into Oracle: Act as the primary marketing liaison with Oracle marketing, coordinating across Oracle corporate marketing, alliance marketing, field marketing, product marketing, communications, industry marketing, and events.

- Event Leadership: Own the strategy and execution for key Oracle events, including Oracle AI AWorld and Oracle Sales Kickoffs, and ensure Oracle’s sponsorship and integration into Celonis’s flagship events, including Celosphere and Process Intelligence Days. Event responsibilities include event strategy, messaging, executive experience, customer speaker recruitment and preparation, booth activation, campaign integration, and post-event pipeline follow-up.

- Track and Analyze Performance: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the effectiveness of Oracle marketing activities, delivering quarterly business reviews with performance insights and actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.

- 8–12+ years of enterprise B2B technology marketing experience, with demonstrated expertise across partner marketing, field marketing, integrated campaign management, and product marketing.

- Previous Oracle marketing, alliance marketing, partner marketing, or field marketing experience strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated success navigating Oracle's highly matrixed marketing organization — including Corporate Marketing, Alliance Marketing, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Communications, and Industry Marketing.

- Banking: Retail and Institutional Operations, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and Payments

- Insurance: Claims (Loss Ratios), Underwriting (Risk Selection), and Policy Servicing

At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation supporting customers in Brazil, by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their [Core Functional Area] ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

- Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.

- Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.

- Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.

- Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.

- Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

- Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.

- AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.

- Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.

- Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements.

- Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English communication with commanding executive presence.

- Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.

- Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics, comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

- Knowledge of Brazil marker is required.

What Celonis can offer you:

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is an individual contributor role - the "Lead / Principal" title refers to the seniority in this case which will be assessed during the hiring process.

Identify & Frame Value

- Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers

- Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

- Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement

- Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives

- Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

- Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing

- Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion

- Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

- Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

- Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)

- Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality

At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.)

The Role

As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption.

The Work You’ll Do

Pre-Sales:

- Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity.

- Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals.

- Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans.

- Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.

- Aligning client expectations with operational feasibility to prevent post-sale scope creep.

Post-Sales: Initiate and Connect

Define the strategy and oversee junior Consultants covering -

- Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

- Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

- Direct AI deployment agents to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements – do we make this less of a must have?

- Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

- Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

- Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

- Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

- Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

- Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

- Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

- Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

- Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually – still hands on technical?

Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

The Engine Orchestration team builds and operates the distributed services that run, scale and balance the analytical query engines. We are the layer that turns a customer's model into something they and their AI agents can query interactively using our Process Query Language across enterprise-sized datasets.

The team actively evolves our new premium query engine, collaborating with multiple other teams across time zones. New features, improved operationability, robust security, and allowing for scalable customer workloads are ours to design and ship.

Our defining program right now is a multi-year migration of the query engine that has powered Celonis for years onto our new premium query engine. It is one of the largest and highest-leverage engineering efforts in the company.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead both the engineering that evolves the new premium query engine and the execution of milestones within the migration program that moves customer workloads onto it.

This is not a lift and shift. The two query engines evolved with different focus areas and the new premium query engine serves different forward looking use cases, so the job is keeping customer workloads running seamlessly throughout. You will analyze how the engines differ on real customer workloads, develop tooling, classify the root causes, and turn them into concrete follow up actions across teams.

Continuous operations are a crucial part of your job. You will help keep the engines and their orchestration healthy while the entire fleet moves underneath them, because a migration on this scale does not get a pause in customer traffic to work with.

jobs.description:

Location: Madrid. Customer base will be in across the EMEA region, with a focus on the DACH area, involving travel to meet clients in person.

Role Description

As an Applied AI Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.

Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

- Discovery & AI Solutioning

- Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)

- Scoping business and technical requirements

- Effectively handling objections

- Developing industry domain knowledge

- Delivering impactful presentations and demos

- Understanding value selling and realization

- Managing customer accounts

What You'll Do:

- AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle

- Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems

- Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

- Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.

- Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

- Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.

- Ensure Successful Project Outcome: AI Solution Consultants stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached

- Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

As a CVP, you will spearhead our mission of AI-driven business transformations with our most strategic customers. You will lead extensive teams of Celonis experts to ensure the success and satisfaction of some of our top customer base on their journey to realizing value with Celonis.

The CVP is the accountable lead for customer success, acting as the trusted advisor for a strategic customer. This involves engaging with C-Level Executives to collaboratively define the long-term vision for utilizing Celonis to transform their business while mobilizing the necessary Celonis resources. In collaboration with our cross-functional Celonis teams, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. The CVP will also champion transformational initiatives across Celonis and customer accounts, fostering innovation and strategic change to maximize value and drive business transformation.

We seek experienced professionals with a proven track record in managing executive relationships, driving profitable growth, and blending industry expertise with strong analytical and consulting skills. Join us at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide and help guide our customers to become the next Lighthouse Celonis customers.

Accountable Program Lead & Engagement Manager

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level internal / external executives, embedding Celonis into their strategic objectives.

- Mentor and coach team members, providing guidance and support for their success, and offer feedback to managers on team performance.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer, Design Operations: AI-Powered Design Platform
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Why this role matters

Great design at enterprise scale isn't just about craft, it's about the tooling, automation, and guardrails that let a design org move fast and stay consistent. At Celonis, that machine now runs on AI: designers use AI coding agents and generation tools every day, and our design system is being made agent-ready so those tools produce on-brand, accessible work by default.

This role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and product. You'll design and build the platform that makes all of this work, the internal tooling, automation, and agent-pipeline infrastructure behind our design practice, bringing real UX judgment to tools the design org actually uses, and governing how AI is used safely and measurably. It's a senior, hands-on role for someone who designs and builds tools, not just processes.

About the team

You'll join the team that owns Celonis's design system and the operations behind how design gets done. We turn a talented group of designers into a high-performing, consistent practice — and increasingly, we integrate AI tooling into every step of the workflow without sacrificing quality, security, or brand integrity.

What you'll do

- Design and build internal tools and automations with strong UX, so the design org's own tooling is genuinely usable, not just functional, using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, APIs, and the Figma plugin/REST APIs.

- Engineer the agent pipeline: stand up and maintain the MCP servers, context pipelines, and integrations that connect the design system to AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Copilot).

- Automate governance-as-code: build CI checks, release automation, and policy enforcement so standards are guardrails in the pipeline rather than docs nobody reads.

- Own and govern the AI tool stack: evaluate, integrate, license, and roll out tools, and partner with security and legal on data/IP review and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

- Instrument and report on impact: build telemetry and dashboards for design-system and AI-tool adoption, cycle time, and quality that leadership actually uses.

- Collaborate with designers, PMs, and engineers to derive and evolve the design system and the workflows around it.

- Build prompt and template infrastructure, reusable prompts, specs, and starter kits, so AI-assisted quality is consistent across the org.

- Set tooling and operations standards, lead platform initiatives, and mentor designers and engineers across the practice.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you'll bring

- Around 5–8 years across design engineering, front-end, design-systems tooling, or platform/internal-tools engineering, with genuine design/UX sensibility, not engineering-only.

- Good UX instincts: you can design a usable tool and translate ambiguous needs into thoughtful solutions, with a foundation in HTML/CSS and front-end craft.

- Strong engineering skills, comfortable building real tools and automations (TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python), working with APIs, CI/CD, and integrations.

- Solid working knowledge of Figma at an organizational level and its plugin/REST APIs.

- A track record of measurably improving how a design or product team works through tooling and automation.

- Hands-on fluency with AI tooling and a thoughtful, responsible point of view on governing it at work.

- A strong product mindset and bias toward ownership, plus the communication and leadership of a senior IC.

Bonus points

- Experience building or operating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar AI integration infrastructure.

- Experience standing up AI tool governance (access, licensing, security/IP review, usage policy) at org scale.

- Familiarity with design tokens and Code Connect, including Angular/TypeScript and CSS custom properties, enough to keep the agent-ready pipeline healthy.

- Experience building dashboards / telemetry for tooling adoption and impact.

- Background supporting design in complex B2B / enterprise or data-heavy environments.

How we work

This is a senior role: you'll own major areas of our tooling and platform with full autonomy, design and build with a high bar, set the standards others rely on, lead initiatives, and mentor. We value people who bring AI into the workflow thoughtfully: faster and safer, never at the cost of quality or trust.

jobs.title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (France) - Orbit Program
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Location: Madrid/Spain for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Paris after. Customer base will be in France, involving travel to meet clients in person.

Start date: 1st of February 2027.

Role Description

As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.

Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

- Discovery & AI Solutioning

- Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)

- Scoping business and technical requirements

- Effectively handling objections

- Developing industry domain knowledge

- Delivering impactful presentations and demos

- Understanding value selling and realization

- Managing customer accounts

What You'll Do:

- AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle

- Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems

- Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

- Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.

- Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

- Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.

- Ensure Successful Project Outcome: AI Solution Consultants stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached

- Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You Need:

- Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.

- Excellent academic performance

- Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.

- Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.

Key Responsibilities

- AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand the client's overarching AI strategy and the distinct challenges that are distinct to their business. As a Celonis product expert, translate these complex, multi-tiered requirements into innovative AI solutions that drive measurable impact..

Predictive Modeling and Optimization: Leverage data stored within the Celonis context model to design and deploy advanced time-series forecasting, optimization, and predictive algorithms to solve complex logistics constraints (e.g., dynamic inventory routing, schedule optimization).

- Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Actively drive the full customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during the pre-sales cycle, and remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation, ensuring agreed value and adoption thresholds in the supply chain are successfully reached.

- Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a „can-do“ attitude, and don’t shy away from complex, fragmented supply chain networks. Leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons, solving critical pain points in planning, sourcing, manufacturing, and distribution.

- Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale, enabling a fundamental shift from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform (e.g., autonomous inventory rebalancing or intelligent shipment exception handling).

- Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. This includes architecting and delivering secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with RAG, tools, and guardrails, while seamlessly integrating with enterprise systems of record.

- Technical Context: You understand the modern banking technology stack (Legacy Mainframe vs. Cloud modernization, Swift, FIX protocol) and how to apply Process Intelligence within that landscape.

- Program Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stream programs. You have managed initiatives where multiple projects run in parallel under one strategic umbrella, requiring strict dependency management and cross-functional alignment.

- Value Realization: A track record of driving large-scale transformation programs that impacted the P&L through operational efficiency or risk mitigation.

- Stakeholder Management: Extensive experience presenting to and influencing C-Level executives (CIO, COO, CFO, CRO). You can navigate complex, matrixed organizations and use data to persuade senior stakeholders.

AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers' AI strategies and sector-specific challenges (e.g., demand forecasting, out-of-stock prevention, shelf placement, trade spend analytics). Find the best problem-solution fit and translate business requirements into innovative, needle-moving solutions.

Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Drive the full customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during pre-sales, and remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation and ensure agreed value and adoption thresholds are met.

Agentic Process Transformation: Shift customers from traditional, rule-based automation to autonomous AI agents empowered by Process Intelligence (e.g., autonomous inventory replenishment, intelligent deduction management), ensuring real ROI on AI deployments.

Proof Projects: Architect and execute business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. Deliver secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with RAG, tools, and guardrails, integrating seamlessly with enterprise retail data, identity protocols, and consumer data privacy frameworks.

Omnichannel & DTC Transformation: Act as a technical advisor on the transition to seamless omnichannel and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) execution. Optimize order-to-cash cycles, customer returns processing, dynamic pricing models, and loyalty program integrations.

Sustainable Supply Chain & Eco-Fulfillment: Drive technical strategy for sustainable retail operations. Focus on tracking Scope 3 emissions, optimizing cold-chain efficiency, reducing perishable food waste, and streamlining sustainable packaging workflows across the distribution network.

Our Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI, who we refer to internally as Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects, pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI (referred to internally as a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer) you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

- Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

- Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

- Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements

- Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

- Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

- Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

- Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

- Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

- Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

- Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

- Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

- Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually

- You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly

- You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers

- You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer

- You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

- Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.

- Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.

- AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

- Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.

- Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

- Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

- Languages: Fluency in English and German required.

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

- Discovery & AI Solutioning

- Scoping business and technical requirements

- Effectively handling objections

- Developing industry domain knowledge

- Delivering impactful presentations and demos

- Understanding value selling and realization

- Managing customer accounts

As a Senior Value Engineer specializing in the Public Sector, you are pushing the envelope in solving critical operational challenges for State and Local Government agencies. You will be working with our most strategic public sector clients, understanding their unique objectives—from enhancing citizen services and modernizing legacy systems to optimizing grant management and regulatory compliance—and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with top AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI, and Databricks.

You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to government CIOs and Agency Directors, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realization to increase the footprint of Celonis across state and local governments.

Key Responsibilities:

-

AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand public sector AI strategies and specific agency challenges (e.g., benefits administration backlogs, procurement bottlenecks, public safety resource allocation, or permitting delays). -

Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a „can-do“ attitude, and don’t shy away from complex legacy processes. Leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in agency hackathons, solving critical pain points to improve constituent experiences.

-

Agentic Process Transformation: Support our government customers in achieving real value out of AI deployments at scale, enabling a fundamental shift from traditional, rigid, paper-heavy workflows to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform (e.g., intelligent case triaging or automated compliance checks).

-

Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of critical Proof-of-Value projects. This includes architecting and delivering secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with RAG, tools, and guardrails, while seamlessly integrating with government enterprise data, identity protocols, and stringent compliance/security frameworks (e.g., StateRAMP, HIPAA, CJIS).

-

Domain & Industry Leadership: Serve as the internal and external technical subject matter expert for the State & Local Government vertical, scaling knowledge across the organization regarding agency processes and public sector nuances.

-

Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails suited for highly scrutinized public sector environments.

Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. The Team:

The Global Lead, GTM Strategy and Planning will work as part of the Revenue Operations leadership team, reporting to the SVP Revenue Operations. This role is the strategic architect of Celonis' annual and multi-year GTM planning processes, coordinating across Sales, Marketing, Value Engineering, Services, Finance, and the broader business to ensure aligned, balanced, and executable go-to-market strategy. This person is responsible for ensuring our GTM investments, resource allocation, and organizational structure are optimized to drive sustainable growth and performance.

The Role:

This role owns the design and execution of our integrated GTM planning processes. You will lead comprehensive territory planning, segmentation strategy, role definition, and resource allocation exercises that balance growth objectives with sustainable unit economics. You will be the custodian of our GTM ratios and thought leader on how we structure our go-to-market. You will design and maintain the planning systems and frameworks we use to make decisions, while also being comfortable working offline and with custom modeling to stress-test plans and guide strategic decisions. You will coordinate senior stakeholders across the business to build consensus around the plan and drive alignment on priorities, resource allocation, and GTM strategy. Beyond planning, you will run critical programs and projects throughout the year that ladder up to the plan—such as Global Accounts management, New Logo strategy, and organizational design initiatives.

The work you’ll do:

- Lead the annual GTM planning process; coordinate across all business functions to build an integrated, bottom-up and top-down plan that balances growth with profitability

- Develop and maintain territory and segment strategy; design territory structures that optimize for pipeline generation, ACV/ARR growth, and team productivity

- Define and refine GTM ratios (AE to SDR, territories to manager, etc.); analyze performance and recommend adjustments to optimize resource allocation

- Conduct role and organizational design analysis; think through optimal coverage models, account assignments, and team structures to drive business outcomes

- Build and maintain planning systems and frameworks; ensure consistency and rigor in how we approach planning, modeling, and decision-making

- Develop and test custom models and scenarios to stress-test plans; guide leadership through trade-offs and help them understand implications of different strategic choices
