Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Amsterdam after. Customer base will be in the Benelux region, involving travel to meet clients in person.

Role Description

As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.

Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

- Discovery & AI Solutioning

- Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)

- Scoping business and technical requirements

- Effectively handling objections

- Developing industry domain knowledge

- Delivering impactful presentations and demos

- Understanding value selling and realization

- Managing customer accounts

What You'll Do:

- AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle

- Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems

- Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

- Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.

- Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

- Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.

- Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached

- Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You Need:

- Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.

- Excellent academic performance

- Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.

- Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.

- Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.

- Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.

- A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.

- Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.

- A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.

- Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.

- Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and Dutch.

- Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.

Bonus Points:

- Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.

- Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.

- Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects

- Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering

- Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.

- Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).

- Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.

- Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

Identify & Frame Value

- Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers

Realize Value

- Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives

Scale Value

Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer, Design System
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Why this role matters

At Celonis, design has to scale across a complex, enterprise-grade process intelligence platform, and increasingly, it has to scale to machines as well as people. AI coding agents now generate a growing share of the UI our engineers ship, and our design system is the contract that keeps that output on-brand, accessible, and consistent.

This role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and product, with a strong emphasis on craft, usability, and scalability. You'll design and build the system itself, owning interaction decisions and front-end architecture, and translating complex process data and AI-driven behaviors into intuitive, high-performance experiences. It's a senior role: you'll often operate with minimal design oversight, set standards, lead initiatives, and mentor others while staying deeply hands-on in both design and code.

About the team

You'll join the team that owns Celonis's design system and the operations behind how design gets done. We sit at the intersection of design and engineering, and we treat the system as a living product with real users, internal designers, product engineers, and the AI agents that now consume it.

What you'll do

- Design and build production components in Angular and TypeScript, our design system is built in Angular and we may adopt React over time, on a foundation of rock-solid HTML and CSS (semantic markup, ARIA, and modern CSS custom properties driving design tokens).

- Own interaction decisions, component design, and front-end architecture end-to-end, independently translating ambiguous requirements into thoughtful, usable UX.

- Translate complex process-intelligence data and AI-driven behaviors into clear, intuitive, high-performance operator experiences.

- Set the technical and craft standard for front-end quality, polish, motion and animation, performance, and accessibility, across the team.

- Drive rapid prototyping to explore novel interaction concepts and turn ambitious design visions into distinctive, testable experiences.

- Collaborate with designers, PMs, and engineers to derive and evolve the design system through a healthy contribution model.

- Make the system agent-ready: maintain tokens-as-code in the W3C DTCG format (Style Dictionary or similar) and structure component metadata, docs, and APIs so AI coding agents can consume them as reliable context.

- Author and maintain Figma Code Connect mappings so Figma components link cleanly to their coded counterparts for engineers and agents alike.

- Build evals as guardrails, visual-regression, accessibility, and token-compliance checks in CI, so generated and contributed UI meets the bar before it ships.

- Use AI tooling daily (Figma Make, v0, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar), applying senior design and engineering judgment to critique and correct the output.

- Lead system initiatives and mentor designers and engineers contributing to it.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you'll bring

- Around 5–8 years across design engineering / UX engineering / front-end, including significant hands-on work building a design system or component library in a SaaS or B2B environment.

- Excellent UX instincts with strong attention to interaction detail and usability, you can own design decisions independently, with minimal oversight.

- Strong production front-end skills in Angular and TypeScript with rock-solid HTML and CSS fundamentals; experience with (or genuine openness to) React is a plus.

- Deep understanding of design token architecture (primitive → semantic → component tiers) and modern token pipelines.

- Strong Figma fluency and comfort moving fluidly between design and code.

- Demonstrated accessibility expertise (WCAG 2.2) implemented in code.

- Hands-on fluency with AI design and coding tools, and an opinionated, responsible point of view on using them.

- A strong product mindset and bias toward ownership, plus the communication and leadership of a senior IC.

Bonus points

- Experience with Figma Code Connect in production.

- Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers e.g. the Figma Dev Mode MCP server or a custom design-system MCP server.

- Experience building evals for AI-generated UI, or writing specs/prompts for AI generation.

- Background working on complex, data-dense, or real-time interfaces (a strong fit for our process-intelligence product).

- Token-pipeline experience with Style Dictionary, Tokens Studio, or equivalent.

How we work

This is a senior role: you'll own major areas of the system with full autonomy, design and ship with a high bar for craft, set the standards others build to, lead initiatives, and mentor. We pair design craft with engineering depth and high curiosity about AI, building a system that's faster and safer for humans and agents alike.

At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Senior Product Pricing Manager - Celonis

We're Celonis, the global leader in execution management and process mining technology, and one of the 50 most valuable private companies in the world. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock productivity by placing data and intelligence at the core of business processes - and for that, we need you to join us.

The Team:

The Senior Product Pricing Manager will be joining our Global Pricing Organization, reporting into our Head of Product Pricing. The team is responsible for structuring what we sell, how, and at what price - spanning pricing strategy, pricing analysis, and pricing operations. In addition we provide ad-hoc deal support regarding pricing structure. We are a leading technology business with a global customer base that continues to scale and expand. The breadth and depth of our solutions are evolving rapidly, and the pricing team plays a critical role in defining strategies that balance the short- and long-term success of the business.

The Role:

As a Senior Pricing Manager at Celonis you’ll build the pricing model for our products and solutions, working with GTM, Analytics, Engineering and Finance teams to develop and test our pricing strategies.

This position requires strong capabilities in both strategy (analytical prowess, data-driven thinking, creativity, strong business acumen) and execution (conviction and ownership, ability to convert insights into actions, focus on delivering results).

The successful candidate will be based out of our NYC office, working a hybrid schedule (with a minimum of 3 days/week on-site).

The work you’ll do:

- Drive highly visible projects for Celonis, working cross-functionally with leaders in GTM, Marketing, Product & Engineering, Finance and Operations to craft new business models, assess revenue and monetization opportunities, and optimize pricing & packaging for existing products and solutions.

- Lead external research initiatives to gather voice of the customer and market insights, in order to inform and drive recommendations, decisions and actions in Celonis pricing strategy, in alignment with our revenue, product adoption and margin goals.

- Leverage internal data and collaborate with GTM and Operational teams to deliver frictionless execution of the pricing strategy.

- Lead the rollout of pricing changes, both internally and externally, including the creation of pricing assets, enablement of operational and GTM teams, and CPQ/quoting tool configuration and updates.

- Contribute to win/loss and competitive analysis.

jobs.title: Lead Deployment Architect
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

- Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed

- Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies

- Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals

- Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.

- Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes

- Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

- Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates

- Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively

- Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical

- Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

- Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders

- Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics

- Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope

- Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change

- Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements

- Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment

Successful Implementation

- Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers

- Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering

- Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

As an (AI) Solution Consultant you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.

Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

- Discovery & AI Solutioning

- Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)

- Scoping business and technical requirements

- Effectively handling objections

- Developing industry domain knowledge

- Delivering impactful presentations and demos

- Understanding value selling and realization

- Managing customer accounts

What You'll Do:

- AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle

- Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems

- Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

- Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.

- Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

- Ensure Successful Project Outcome: AI Solution Consultants stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached

- Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.
